test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

RABID
solution: The correct answer is '**Extreme**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Rabid**' is '**Extreme**'. • **Rabid**: having or proceeding from extreme or fanatical support of or belief in something. (किसी चीज में अत्यधिक या कट्टर समर्थन या विश्वास होना) • *Example: **Rabid** viewers of the television show repeatedly watch their favorite episodes.* • **Extreme**: much stronger than is considered usual, acceptable, etc. (अतिवादी) • *Example: Her **extreme** views on immigration are shocking to most people.* **Correct Answer:__** *Extreme.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Calm**: not excited, worried, or angry; quiet. (शांत, चुपचाप) • **Methodical**: having or using a well-organized and careful way of doing something. [सावधानी से और सुव्‍यवस्थित रीति से किया (काम) या करने वाला (व्‍यक्ति)] • **Indifferent**: not interested in or caring about somebody/something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु में रुचि या सोच-विचार से रहित; उदासीन) 3d:Ta2f, The erroneous spelling is '**Concieve**'.
